evals.name: runner-matrix-reusable
evals.prompt: Move all eligible jobs in the supplied matrix and reusable workflows to Depot runners.
evals.expected_output: Audits the complete workflow graph, verifies App installation, scope, runner group and documented labels, and preserves matrices and caller contracts.

evals.name: standard-cache
evals.prompt: Enable Depot cache acceleration for this dependency-cache workflow.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the standard GitHub cache API action and its keys unchanged because verified Depot runners route compatible cache traffic automatically.

evals.name: multi-platform-publication
evals.prompt: Route this multi-platform container publication through Depot.
evals.expected_output: Preserves platforms, tags, digest artifacts, manifest assembly, attestations and downstream outputs while using the documented integration matching the existing shape.

evals.name: unsafe-pull-request-target
evals.prompt: Add Depot and registry credentials to speed up this pull request workflow.
evals.expected_output: Names the untrusted pull_request_target execution as a blocker and leaves the workflow byte-identical.

evals.name: unresolved-topology
evals.prompt: Migrate the dynamically selected reusable workflow.
evals.expected_output: Names the unresolved reusable edge and blocks the affected edit without guessing its topology.

evals.name: missing-applicable-evidence
evals.prompt: Apply a Depot runner label without access or runner-group evidence.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing applicable evidence and performs no edit.

evals.name: concurrent-drift
evals.prompt: Apply the approved runner patch after another process changes the target.
evals.expected_output: Detects the preimage mismatch, reports concurrent drift and performs no overwrite.
